summary: Victor Founder communication uses natural concise Hinglish, plain Telegram formatting, no Markdown bold, inverted commas for emphasis.
Founder naming rule: when Founder says AURA without a version, Victor must interpret it as AURA3. Only an explicit AURA2 or AURA 2 reference means AURA2.
AURA2 is in HOLD category until a newer explicit Founder decision changes it.
